incident_text: High-speed motorcycle crash on Tambaram Flyover. Rider thrown 10 meters, conscious but moaning, severe deformity and arterial bleeding in right thigh, probable open femur fracture. Pulse weak and rapid.
rationale: High-energy polytrauma with arterial bleeding and open femur fracture with signs of hypovolemic shock requires immediate Level 1/2 resuscitation.

incident_text: 55-year-old male factory worker collapsed on the floor in Guindy Industrial Estate. Unresponsive and not breathing. Bystander CPR currently in progress.
rationale: Sudden cardiac arrest with absent breathing and ongoing CPR requires immediate Level 1 resuscitation and bypass.

incident_text: Pillion rider without helmet collided with utility pole on OMR. Deep open depressed skull fracture with active hemorrhage and clear fluid leaking from ear. GCS 6, decerebrate posturing.
rationale: Severe traumatic brain injury with GCS < 8 and skull fracture requires immediate neurosurgical intervention.

incident_text: Pedestrian crushed under rear wheel of heavy lorry near Chromepet signal. Pelvic instability, severe perineal bleeding, patient cold and clammy, unmeasurable blood pressure.
rationale: Crush injury with unstable pelvic fracture and profound hemorrhagic shock constitutes an immediate life threat.

incident_text: Driver trapped in car after high-speed frontal impact. Severe blunt chest trauma against steering wheel, tracheal deviation to left, absent breath sounds on right side, cyanotic and gasping.
rationale: Clinical picture of tension pneumothorax with obstructive shock requiring immediate needle decompression and surgical resuscitation.

incident_text: Factory worker sustained complete traumatic amputation of right arm below elbow in hydraulic stamping press. Massive bleeding partially controlled by improvised rope tourniquet, pale and diaphoretic.
rationale: Traumatic limb amputation with major vascular compromise and hemorrhage constitutes an immediate life threat.

incident_text: Young female stung by multiple hornets in agricultural nursery. Severe inspiratory stridor, swollen lips and tongue, diffuse urticaria, oxygen saturation 78% on room air.
rationale: Severe anaphylactic shock with critical airway compromise and hypoxia mandates immediate epinephrine and advanced airway.

incident_text: Commercial kitchen LPG cylinder flash fire. Chef has deep partial and full-thickness burns covering chest, arms, and face (approx 45% BSA). Singed nasal hair with hoarse voice.
rationale: Extensive burns >40% BSA with suspected inhalation injury requires immediate specialized burn ICU resuscitation.

incident_text: Street altercation resulting in penetrating stab wound to left fourth intercostal space. Bubbling sound with each respiration, profound dyspnea, hypotension.
rationale: Open sucking chest wound with respiratory compromise and possible cardiac/pulmonary laceration.

incident_text: 68-year-old male found collapsed at home 25 minutes ago. Dense right hemiplegia, global aphasia, GCS 8, gurgling secretions, history of atrial fibrillation.
rationale: Acute hyperacute stroke within thrombolysis/thrombectomy window with airway compromise (GCS 8).

incident_text: Auto-rickshaw rolled over into ditch. Driver extricated with flail segment on anterior chest wall, paradoxical chest movements, coughing frothy blood, SpO2 81%.
rationale: Flail chest with pulmonary contusion and hemoptysis creating severe ventilatory failure.

incident_text: 8-year-old child struck by speeding sedan while crossing road. Flung onto pavement, unresponsive, unequal pupils with right pupil fixed and dilated, irregular breathing pattern.
rationale: Pediatric polytrauma with uncal herniation and Cushing's response requires emergency Level 1 pediatric neurotrauma.

incident_text: Middle-aged patient with known cirrhosis vomiting massive amounts of bright red blood. Saturated three towels, systolic blood pressure 60 mmHg, lethargic and cold.
rationale: Massive gastrointestinal variceal bleed with decompensated hypovolemic shock.

incident_text: Submersion incident at Kovalam beach. Pulled from water after 4 minutes underwater, apneic, weak carotid pulse barely palpable at 40 bpm, frothy airway.
rationale: Near-drowning with respiratory arrest and severe profound hypoxia with peri-arrest bradycardia.

incident_text: Electrician contacted 440V distribution box. Flung backwards, pulseless electrical activity, chest compressions commenced immediately by coworker.
rationale: High-voltage electrical shock with cardiac arrest and pulseless electrical activity.

incident_text: 28-year-old female in first trimester with sudden acute lower abdominal tearing pain. Syncope episode 5 minutes ago, marked abdominal guarding, pulse 138, severe pallor.
rationale: Ruptured ectopic pregnancy with massive hemoperitoneum and acute circulatory shock.

incident_text: Boiler explosion at dye processing unit. Victim sustained blast wave and fragmentation injury, abdominal wall rupture with bowel evisceration, conscious but tachycardic and hypotensive.
rationale: High-order blast injury with abdominal evisceration and hemorrhagic shock.

incident_text: Farmer bitten on lower leg by large viper 40 minutes ago. Progressive swelling to groin, active oozing of non-clotting blood from puncture sites and oral mucosa, vomiting dark blood.
rationale: Severe vasculotoxic snake envenomation with systemic consumption coagulopathy and active bleeding.

incident_text: Motorcycle skidded on wet asphalt near Thoraipakkam. Rider has angulated closed deformity of right lower leg (suspected tibia fracture), pedal pulse palpable, severe pain, no wound.
rationale: Closed long-bone fracture with intact neurovascular status requires urgent immobilization and surgery but not immediate life resuscitation.

incident_text: Construction laborer slipped from first-floor scaffolding (approx 3.5m height). Landed on feet, complains of severe lumbar spine and bilateral heel pain, conscious, no sensory loss.
rationale: Axial loading fall with suspected calcaneal and vertebral compression fractures without acute deficit.

incident_text: Car passenger in moderate rear-end impact at 35 km/h. Head struck windshield causing deep 8cm forehead laceration. Bleeding controlled with pressure dressing, fully alert, GCS 15.
rationale: Extensive facial laceration with high mechanism of injury requiring urgent imaging and layered repair.

incident_text: Driver involved in T-bone collision at 40 km/h. Complaining of severe lateral neck pain and midline cervical spine tenderness, wearing seatbelt, ambulatory at scene, vitals stable.
rationale: High-velocity blunt impact with cervical spine tenderness requires spinal immobilization and urgent CT imaging.

incident_text: 40-year-old known asthmatic experiencing acute exacerbation for 4 hours. Speaking in 2-3 word phrases, diffuse expiratory wheezing, SpO2 91% on room air, respiratory rate 28.
rationale: Moderate-to-severe acute asthma exacerbation without immediate exhaustion requiring urgent nebulization and oxygen.

incident_text: 35-year-old male with sudden onset excruciating right flank pain radiating to scrotum. Writhing in agony, diaphoresis, microscopic hematuria reported by clinic, vitals stable.
rationale: Severe acute renal colic with intractable pain requiring urgent parenteral analgesia and evaluation.

incident_text: Cyclist struck by auto-rickshaw handlebar on left flank. Complains of left upper quadrant abdominal tenderness, no signs of peritonitis, blood pressure 118/76, pulse 88.
rationale: Blunt abdominal trauma with localized splenic area tenderness requiring urgent FAST scan and observation.

incident_text: Domestic scald burn from boiling water spilled on anterior right thigh and lower abdomen. Blistering and intense pain, estimated 10% total body surface area, vitals normal.
rationale: Moderate second-degree scald burn (~10% BSA) requiring urgent fluid resuscitation and burn dressing.

incident_text: Type 1 diabetic patient feeling progressively lethargic with nausea and deep breathing for 24 hours. Random blood glucose 480 mg/dL, alert and oriented, pulse 110.
rationale: Suspected diabetic ketoacidosis without severe coma requiring urgent IV rehydration and insulin protocol.

incident_text: Security guard attacked by aggressive street dog. Multiple deep puncture wounds and 5cm tearing laceration on right calf, active venous oozing, rabies status of dog unknown.
rationale: Category III animal bite with deep soft tissue tearing requiring urgent thorough wound debridement and rabies immunoglobulin.

incident_text: Scooter rider lost balance at low speed. Landed on abducted arm, prominent anterior shoulder deformity, inability to move joint, severe pain, radial pulse intact.
rationale: Acute anterior shoulder dislocation requiring urgent closed reduction under procedural sedation.

incident_text: 72-year-old female tripped over rug at home. Cannot stand, right lower limb is shortened and externally rotated, severe groin pain on palpation, neurovascular intact.
rationale: Classic presentation of femoral neck / intertrochanteric fracture requiring urgent stabilization.

incident_text: Restaurant employee cut palm on broken porcelain plate. 4cm deep palmar laceration, venous bleeding controlled with gauze wrap, able to flex all fingers, vitals normal.
rationale: Deep palmar laceration with potential tendon/nerve proximity requiring urgent exploration and surgical repair.

incident_text: 24-year-old pregnant female (26 weeks) with acute right lower quadrant abdominal pain, low-grade fever of 101F, localized tenderness and rebound, nausea.
rationale: Suspected acute appendicitis in pregnancy requiring urgent obstetric and general surgical ultrasound.

incident_text: Carpenter experienced angle grinder kickback. Deep 6cm muscle-depth laceration across anterior forearm, bleeding controlled with firm towel, fingers warm and mobile.
rationale: High-energy soft tissue laceration with muscular involvement requiring urgent surgical irrigation.

incident_text: 16-year-old boy with sudden onset severe unilateral left testicular pain starting 1 hour ago during football. Nausea and vomiting, testis high-riding and exquisitely tender.
rationale: Suspected acute testicular torsion with 6-hour surgical viability window requiring immediate Doppler ultrasound.

incident_text: Two-wheeler collision at 25 km/h. Passenger had brief 10-second loss of consciousness, now awake and answering questions, headache, vomited once, GCS 14.
rationale: Mild-to-moderate traumatic brain injury with transient LOC and vomiting meeting Canadian CT Head Rule criteria for urgent scan.

incident_text: Laboratory technician accidentally splashed caustic soda solution into left eye. Severe burning and blepharospasm, saline irrigation commenced immediately at scene.
rationale: Ocular chemical burn requiring urgent emergency department continuous Morgan lens irrigation and ophthalmology review.

incident_text: 14-year-old teenager fell from skateboard on paved sidewalk. Superficial abrasions on both knees and palms, minor bleeding stopped, fully ambulatory without assistance.
rationale: Isolated superficial abrasions with normal ambulation and zero hemodynamic or bony compromise.

incident_text: Scooter skidded at 10 km/h while turning into driveway. Minor gravel scrape on outer forearm, no head injury, patient standing and conversing normally.
rationale: Minor low-speed road rash without structural injury suitable for delayed primary care.

incident_text: Commuter stepped off bus awkwardly and twisted left ankle. Mild swelling over lateral malleolus, able to bear weight and walk gingerly, no deformity.
rationale: Inversion ankle injury satisfying Ottawa Ankle Rules for non-emergent outpatient assessment.

incident_text: Kitchen worker cut index finger while chopping onions. 1cm superficial skin cut, bleeding stopped after 2 minutes of direct pressure with napkin, full tendon motion.
rationale: Superficial finger laceration with hemostasis and intact neurovascular function.

incident_text: 45-year-old male with 3-week history of dull lower back stiffness. Pain slightly increased after lifting grocery bag this morning, walking normally, no bowel/bladder issues.
rationale: Subacute mechanical back pain without red flag symptoms or neurological compromise.

incident_text: Bumper tap in bumper-to-bumper city traffic at 5 km/h. Driver complains of mild muscular neck stiffness, no vehicle damage, full range of movement, fully alert.
rationale: Minimal velocity impact with mild muscular strain and absence of cervical spine tenderness.

incident_text: Gardener stung by single honeybee on dorsal hand. Localized 2cm redness and mild swelling, normal breathing, no systemic symptoms or generalized rash.
rationale: Localized insect sting reaction without systemic allergic symptoms.

incident_text: Touched hot pressure cooker lid while cooking. Small 1cm blister on thumb, mild pain relieved after cold water application, fully functional.
rationale: Superficial minor burn <1% BSA without joint contracture risk.

incident_text: Worker stepped on wooden splinter with sandals. Small wooden sliver visible under epidermis of heel, minimal pain, no bleeding or signs of infection.
rationale: Superficial non-infected foreign body suitable for minor clinic removal.

incident_text: Passenger jammed elbow against car door frame while getting inside. Mild localized bruising over olecranon, full elbow flexion and extension, no neurovascular deficit.
rationale: Simple soft tissue contusion with intact bone structure and range of motion.

incident_text: Child had spontaneous anterior nosebleed during hot afternoon. Bleeding completely ceased after 5 minutes of nostril pinching, child playing happily.
rationale: Resolved anterior epistaxis with normal vital signs and active behavior.

incident_text: Pedestrian stumbled on uneven pavement stone. Mild scrape on shin through trousers, minimal spot bleeding, ambulating with normal gait.
rationale: Superficial minor abrasion with independent ambulation and no fractures.

incident_text: High-speed highway accident where motorcycle impacted guardrail. Decapitation of rider with head separated from torso. Non-survivable catastrophic injuries, absent vital signs.
rationale: Catastrophic decapitation with injuries incompatible with life; expectant/deceased protocol.

incident_text: Pedestrian crushed beneath overturned cement mixer truck for over 3 hours. Massive cranial crush with exposed brain matter, dependent lividity and rigor mortis confirmed by primary responder.
rationale: Crush injuries incompatible with life with confirmed rigor mortis; deceased category.
